grouping_resolution.note: Single item-level primary source; no grouping ambiguity.

sources.title: COVESA 2024 Highlights
sources.role: Official COVESA year-in-review used for consortium chronology, SDV Alliance launch and VSS/ecosystem activity.

claims.text: COVESA reports that the SDV Alliance, a collaboration of AUTOSAR, COVESA, Eclipse SDV and SOAFEE, was launched at CES 2024.
claims.context: Consortium chronology on an official COVESA retrospective page.

claims.text: COVESA reports that member companies began aligning initiatives including VSS with the European Commission Software Defined Vehicle of the Future roadmap during 2024.
claims.context: COVESA account of ecosystem alignment; not an independent measure of adoption.

claims.text: The page reports creation of a Commercial Vehicle Expert Group working with truck OEM/fleet organizations to extend VSS for commercial-vehicle purposes.

limitations.text: This is a consortium year-in-review and mixes technical, membership, event and marketing milestones; it is stronger for ecosystem chronology than for architecture mechanics.

targets.target: Verify the official scope/status and architecture-significant statements on covesa-2024-highlights; distinguish directly checkable facts from organization/project claims.
targets.finding: The page reliably establishes COVESA's 2024 ecosystem chronology, including SDV Alliance and VSS-related activities, but it is not a technical specification.

editorial.why_now_note: The 2024 review helps explain cross-consortium convergence around SDV interfaces but is not itself a technical architecture artifact.
editorial.rationale: Useful chronology/supporting context; Candidate Selection should prefer concrete specifications, implementations and technical papers for architecture claims.
